492.note: Stock head c606c6b2. Stock dual SMGs and L42, 59/84 memory. Initial avatar NAV readback was region 17 polygon 3. The reported z2300 was the sector anchor. The exact avatar position before the move was unverified. The operator disclosed and verified a manual ?tp to the planned (17000,495,6400) before all witnessed cases, resetting QAOther to z7200 as well. Direct Fire refused an ally and the far target without costs/reuse. Actual stock 492 and 493 cast 2s, paid 45/50, take 10s own/5s group690 and stay outside combat. 492 26/24 under +20 typed armor, Root stat99 and 8s linked removals on 6114/6113; the helper move is corrected to z7200 then succeeds to z7220. 493 43/40 and one natural 10s Enrage with matching paired removals on QAEnemy, after a normal non-proc. QAOther at 8m kept neutral damage. In-cone ally QAFriend and QAFar 8m+1 world unit received no hit. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/972#issuecomment-7101369244
